purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of additional exposure, built-environment and impact-validation sources relevant to catastrophe risk.

entries.name: Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal Dataset v1
entries.spatial_scope: Africa, South Asia, South-East Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean
entries.resolution_or_granularity: annual rasters with approximately 4 m effective spatial resolution, distributed at 0.5 m pixel spacing
entries.note: Google documents dual CC BY 4.0 / ODbL 1.0 reuse and explicitly includes commercial social-good users; a future admission should select one licence path and exact annual assets. Presence, fractional counts and height are model-derived Sentinel-2 products, not cadastral observations.

entries.name: DLR World Settlement Footprint 2019
entries.provider: German Aerospace Center (DLR) Earth Observation Center
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 10 m binary settlement mask derived from multitemporal Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery
entries.note: DLR labels the product CC BY 4.0 and provides DOI, download, STAC and WMS access. It is a remotely sensed binary settlement classification with omission/commission uncertainty, not a building inventory; exact tiles and attribution still require source-specific admission review.

entries.name: DLR World Settlement Footprint Evolution
entries.provider: German Aerospace Center (DLR) Earth Observation Center
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 30 m settlement-evolution raster plus yearly Input Data Consistency score
entries.note: DLR labels the dataset CC BY 4.0. Landsat availability varies strongly over space and time; preserve the yearly Input Data Consistency score and treat encoded years as estimated settlement detection rather than authoritative construction dates or annual building counts.

entries.name: DLR World Settlement Footprint 3D
entries.provider: German Aerospace Center (DLR) Earth Observation Center
entries.temporal_scope: released 2023; current service exposes V02 layers
entries.resolution_or_granularity: approximately 90 m global gridded building height, area, volume and fraction layers
entries.note: DLR labels WSF 3D CC BY 4.0 and the current service exposes V02 layer identifiers. The fields are model-derived 90 m aggregates informed by remote sensing and ancillary data, not verified structure-level heights, areas or values.

entries.name: USACE National Structure Inventory Base 2026
entries.provider: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Hydrologic Engineering Center
entries.resolution_or_granularity: point-based modeled structure inventory with standardized public attributes; state files and API subsets
entries.note: USACE documents the 2026 Base as a public modeled national inventory and older NSI guidance states the public release removes fields derived from licensed data. A canonical current standard licence for redistribution/commercial reuse was not established in this landscape check, so rights stay fail-closed. Values and attributes are modeled estimates, not structure-by-structure truth.

entries.name: FEMA USA Structures
entries.provider: U.S. Federal Emergency Management Agency / Oak Ridge National Laboratory / U.S. Geological Survey
entries.temporal_scope: rolling national inventory; federal catalogue metadata last modified 2025-04-01
entries.resolution_or_granularity: building-footprint inventory of structures greater than 450 square feet with occupancy attribution
entries.note: The federal catalogue identifies public access and U.S. government-works licensing guidance. A future admission must still freeze an exact FEMA/ArcGIS release or service snapshot and verify field-level provenance. Occupancy classifications combine automated inference and source fusion and are not cadastral or assessor truth.

entries.name: OpenFEMA NFIP Redacted Claims v3
entries.provider: U.S. Federal Emergency Management Agency / National Flood Insurance Program
entries.spatial_scope: United States National Flood Insurance Program
entries.resolution_or_granularity: redacted flood-insurance claim transactions; current v3 service contains more than 2.7 million records
entries.note: High-value empirical insurance-impact evidence, but current OpenFEMA v3 metadata marks access public while leaving the licence field unset; redistribution and commercial-use rights therefore remain fail-closed pending source-specific review. Preserve redaction, transaction semantics, monetary vintage and programme-policy changes rather than treating rows as homogeneous loss observations.

entries.name: OpenFEMA NFIP Redacted Policies v3
entries.provider: U.S. Federal Emergency Management Agency / National Flood Insurance Program
entries.spatial_scope: United States National Flood Insurance Program
entries.resolution_or_granularity: redacted policy transactions; current v3 service contains more than 74 million records
entries.note: A natural exposure denominator and companion to NFIP claims, but current OpenFEMA v3 metadata marks access public while leaving the licence field unset; rights remain fail-closed pending source-specific review. Policy transaction rows must be reconstructed carefully and must not be treated directly as a clean contemporaneous in-force portfolio.

entries.name: OpenFEMA Individual Assistance Multiple Loss Flood Properties v1
entries.temporal_scope: 2002-present; declarations older than 30 days; service metadata declares daily refresh
entries.resolution_or_granularity: applicant/property impact records with privacy-coarsened coordinates, disaster identifiers and flood-impact attributes
entries.note: OpenFEMA metadata marks access as public but leaves its licence field unset and points users to OpenFEMA Terms and Conditions/citation requirements; exact redistribution and commercial-use terms therefore remain fail-closed until admission review. Coordinates are deliberately rounded to one decimal for privacy and can cross county/state boundaries, so aggregate with the supplied geography fields.

entries.name: OpenFEMA Disaster Declarations Summaries v2
entries.temporal_scope: 1953-present; service metadata declares approximately 20-minute refresh cadence
entries.resolution_or_granularity: declaration and declared-area records with disaster numbers, incident types, dates and programme flags
entries.note: Useful as the event-identity spine for other OpenFEMA impact datasets. Current OpenFEMA metadata marks access as public but leaves its licence field unset, so source-specific reuse rights remain fail-closed pending terms review; county detail is unavailable before 1964 and historical records include known incompleteness and human-entry error.
